operations.notes: Fake-client baseline from llm-generator.snapshot.test.ts. Drop + recreate cognitive_test, apply 12 migrations, chunk a tiny 2-paragraph corpus into 2 chunks at chunk_size=400, fake client inserts one entity per chunk, pg_dump --format=custom via docker exec. The full §3.4 path runs except the LLM call itself. Real-Claude smoke is captured below as 'pending'.

Live smoke pending. Requires the platform server (port 3000), ml-services (port 8000), Ollama (port 11434), and a Claude API key. Run procedure: (1) start the stack: `make up && cd ml-services && make ml && cd ../platform && pnpm dev`; (2) `pnpm tsx scripts/snapshot-ensure.ts frankenstein-10chunks`. The corpus is committed at platform/src/test/corpora/frankenstein-ch1-10.txt (~144 KB, 73 chunks @ 2000-byte chunk_size). With Haiku 4.5 + nomic-embed-text, expected wall-clock per chunk is 5-15 s, total ≈70 chunks * 10 s = ≈700 s (12 min). §5.1 target is < 5 min, hard cap < 15 min — running the full corpus will likely exceed the target band on first generation. j77.4 follow-up should consider parallelising the queue (currently FIFO serial) or trimming the corpus to fewer chunks if the threshold has to hold. Capture the wall-clock + per-chunk distribution + final entity / fact counts here once the smoke runs.

Verified via test 'throws ChunkTimeoutError + records partial=true on the manifest'. Stuck client (queued=1, draining=true forever); 200 ms manifest timeout fires; partial=true and partial_chunk_index=0 land in the manifest stats; ChunkTimeoutError surfaces to the caller with exit code 2. Behaviour matches §3.4 step 6 / §6 'regeneration partial' edge case.

Reports `pending-first-generate` rather than `missing` because the manifest's expected_hashes is empty and regenerated_at is null. Exit code 0 — committed manifest entries that haven't been generated against the live stack don't break CI. Once the first smoke runs, the entry transitions to `ok` (or `mismatch` if drift).
